name: Hot banh duc
summary: Bánh đúc nóng is a hot bowl of soft, sticky, dense bánh đúc topped with minced pork stir-fried with wood ear, fried shallot, and herbs.
origin: Cao Bang city, in the afternoon.
howToEat: Eat it in the afternoon with broth or a strong dip, best when the weather turns cool.
where: Afternoon stalls in Cao Bang city.
seoTitle: Hot banh duc in Cao Bang

texture: Báo Cao Bằng on 1 September 2026 says the bowl is soft, sticky, and dense.
